class.name: ReloadedPlugin
class.brief_description: A plugin of Rails Reloaded: what it is for the player, and what it adds to the core.
class.description: A plugin brings its classes and servers to the core at two points of the library's start: its classes once every core class is registered, since they derive from them; its servers once the vehicle servers exist and before the servers that follow model instances. Its servers go in reverse at the same point of the library's end. [ReloadedPluginServer] holds the plugins.
